judge.rationale: The candidate even fails its own acceptance test (`conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` expects a `ws` category error log with `userId` when `listFor` throws, which the candidate left unimplemented in `messageHandler.ts`) and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratchpad in the diff. It uses the wrong message types and interface names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` / `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` / `ConversationSummary`). It completely misses the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag, the `UNSUPPORTED` error code, `StoreCannotList`, and the upper bound on `limit` (1-200, allowing 0 and >200 instead). Furthermore, it returns an empty list `sessions: []` when `listFor` is missing on the store, which explicitly violates the ticket's requirement to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never an empty list. Finally, it omits the updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
